"""Independent qualification/acceptance of configuration obstruction evidence."""
from pathlib import Path
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd()))
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
from devtools.context.python.project_configuration import (
    PythonConfigurationSelector as K, PythonConfigurationStatus as S,
)
from tests.context.python.project_configuration.test_configuration import _snapshot, _resolve

def case(text):
    with TemporaryDirectory(prefix='devtools-config20-') as temp:
        snapshot=_snapshot(Path(temp).resolve(),{'pyproject.toml':text,'README.md':'retained readme','tests/test_x.py':'','src/pkg/x.py':''})
        return _resolve(snapshot)

def qualify():
    import tomllib
    # Independently establish that these are valid TOML obstruction shapes,
    # not parser errors, wrong public attributes, filesystem or runtime failures.
    for prefix in ['project','tool','tool.pytest','tool.pytest.ini_options','tool.hatch.build.targets','tool.coverage.run','tool.mypy']:
        data=tomllib.loads(prefix+' = 7\n'); assert isinstance(data,dict)
        r=case(prefix+' = 7\n'); assert r.declarations.parse_error is None
    empty=case(''); assert set(empty.declarations.absent_selectors)==set(K); assert not empty.facts
    good=case('[project]\nreadme="README.md"\n'); assert len(good.facts)==1; assert good.assessments[0].status==S.RESOLVED
    assert good==case('[project]\nreadme="README.md"\n')
    leaf=case('[tool.pytest.ini_options]\ntestpaths=42\n'); assert len(leaf.assessments)==1; assert leaf.assessments[0].status==S.UNSUPPORTED
    broken=case('[tool\n'); assert broken.declarations.parse_error=='malformed-toml';assert not broken.declarations.absent_selectors;assert not broken.facts
    obstruction=case('tool=false\n')
    assert set(obstruction.declarations.absent_selectors)==set(K), 'Baseline failure must specifically be false absence, not unrelated failure'
    assert not obstruction.assessments
    print('QUALIFIED: public APIs, valid TOML obstructions, genuine absence, real resolved target, unsupported leaf, parse error; baseline false-absence defect reproduced')

def run_checks():
    cases=0
    for selector in K:
        parts=selector.value.split('.')
        for length in range(1,len(parts)):
            prefix=parts[:length]
            for scalar in ('7','false','"opaque"','[1,2]'):
                result=case('.'.join(prefix)+' = '+scalar+'\n')
                expected={k for k in K if k.value.split('.')[:length]==prefix}
                present={a.declaration.selector for a in result.assessments}
                assert present==expected, ('Missing explicit unsupported obstruction evidence',prefix,scalar,present,expected)
                assert set(result.declarations.absent_selectors)==set(K)-expected
                assert not result.facts
                for a in result.assessments:
                    assert a.status==S.UNSUPPORTED
                    assert a.declaration.unsupported_reason=='non-table-parent'
                    assert a.declaration.key==tuple(a.declaration.selector.value.split('.'))
                    assert a.declaration.item_ordinal is None and a.declaration.value is None
                    assert a.declaration.derivation_identity==result.declarations.derivation_identity
                assert result==case('.'.join(prefix)+' = '+scalar+'\n'), 'Identical retained facts must remain deterministic'
                cases+=1
    sibling=case('[project]\nreadme="README.md"\n[tool]\npytest=false\n')
    assert [(a.declaration.selector,a.status) for a in sibling.assessments]==[(K.README,S.RESOLVED),(K.PYTEST_TESTPATHS,S.UNSUPPORTED)]
    assert len(sibling.facts)==1 and sibling.facts[0].declaration.selector==K.README
    for text in ('','[tool]\n','[tool.pytest]\n'):
        result=case(text);assert set(result.declarations.absent_selectors)==set(K);assert not result.assessments
    empty=case('[tool.pytest.ini_options]\ntestpaths=[]\n')
    assert K.PYTEST_TESTPATHS not in empty.declarations.absent_selectors and not empty.assessments
    leaf=case('[tool.pytest.ini_options]\ntestpaths=42\n');assert leaf.assessments[0].status==S.UNSUPPORTED
    assert leaf.assessments[0].declaration.unsupported_reason=='unsupported-value-form'
    malformed=case('[tool\n');assert malformed.declarations.parse_error=='malformed-toml';assert not malformed.assessments;assert not malformed.declarations.absent_selectors
    print(f'PASS: {cases} obstruction shapes, qualified absence, supported siblings, provenance, deterministic resolution and existing unsupported/parse semantics')

if __name__=='__main__':run_checks()
